main_text.l: Pontificem; petiturque ab eo, vt insinuet,
quid agendum sit de Sacerdotibus, qui Pho-
suos, vt cuncta rite disponerent, & causa
Photij, atque Ignatij a Romano Pontifice
tur rursus a Romano, vt illum in commu-
tum reditum sua auctoritate firmet. Eijci-
tur iterum Photius, & iterum ad Roma-
num Legationes, & literae, vt Acta confir-
set[?], & cum Episcopis deceptis a Photio,
qui mandat utriusque partis Episcopis mitti,
natum ab ipso Christo illis exhibitum
super Ecclesias non ex ambitione vin-
scopis, universis Christi fidelibus; lites in-
definiunt, in iudicio de rerum veritate inda-

page.notes: Printed text is in roman type with long s rendered as f; transcribed as plain s. The page opens mid-paragraph with no indent, so the first paragraph is marked as a continuation. The Ejicitur/Eijcitur and iudicio/judicio spellings are copied as read; "Eijcitur" is printed with i and j as read. "dispen-set" is read from the hyphenated "difpen-" / "fet" across the line end and is doubtful. A small mark at the bottom left is not a legible signature and is left out. No marginal notes and no running head are printed.
